$comment: Local supplement merged into spec/openapi.json by Recommand.Generator. The upstream OpenAPI document no longer describes webhook delivery payloads; these schemas are maintained by hand from https://docs.recommand.eu/docs/working-with-webhooks. spec/openapi.json itself is an unmodified upstream snapshot.

WebhookPayload.title: Webhook Payload
WebhookPayload.description: Discriminated union of all webhook payload types, selected by `eventType`.

DocumentReceivedWebhook.title: Document Received Webhook
DocumentReceivedWebhook.description: Sent when an inbound document is received and stored for a company.

documentId.description: ID of the transmitted document. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

DocumentSentWebhook.title: Document Sent Webhook
DocumentSentWebhook.description: Sent when a document is sent. Delivery can still be pending at this point.

documentId.description: ID of the transmitted document. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

deliveryStatus.description: Delivery status at the time of the event. Null on older queued events.

DocumentDeliveryStatusChangedWebhook.title: Document Delivery Status Changed Webhook
DocumentDeliveryStatusChangedWebhook.description: Sent when one delivery of a document changes status.

documentId.description: ID of the transmitted document. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

deliveryId.description: ID of the delivery that changed.

address.description: Address the delivery was made to, e.g. a Peppol address or an email address.

previousStatus.description: Status before the change. Null for a newly created deferred fallback attempt.

failure.description: Why the delivery failed. Null when no failure applies.

DocumentReportingStatusChangedWebhook.title: Document Reporting Status Changed Webhook
DocumentReportingStatusChangedWebhook.description: Sent when a French e-reporting report changes status with the tax administration.

documentId.description: ID of the transmitted document. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

periodEnd.description: End of the reporting period (date). Null until known.

outcomeCode.description: Outcome code from the tax administration. Null until known.

DocumentLabelAssignedWebhook.title: Document Label Assigned Webhook
DocumentLabelAssignedWebhook.description: Sent when a label is added to a document.

documentId.description: ID of the transmitted document. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

labelId.description: ID of the label that was assigned.

DocumentLabelUnassignedWebhook.title: Document Label Unassigned Webhook
DocumentLabelUnassignedWebhook.description: Sent when a label is removed from a document.

documentId.description: ID of the transmitted document. Fetch it with GET /api/v1/documents/{documentId}.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

labelId.description: ID of the label that was removed.

CompanyVerificationWebhook.title: Company Verification Webhook
CompanyVerificationWebhook.description: Sent when a company verification finishes.

teamId.description: ID of the team the event belongs to.

companyId.description: ID of the company the event belongs to.

errorMessage.description: Failure reason. Always present when status is `error`; may be present when `rejected`.
